title: Double Every Score
instructions:
Complete the `doubleScores` function. It takes a `List<Int>` of match scores and returns a new `List<Int>` where every score is doubled.

Use the `.map` function to transform the list.

For example, `doubleScores(listOf(45, 72, 38))` returns `[90, 144, 76]`.
hint: Use scores.map { it * 2 } to double each element.
